सम्-प्राव् (-प्र-अव्) P. -प्रवति, to assist together, aid, help, AV.

सम्-प्रीणन n. (fr. Caus.) gladdening, delighting, BhP.
सम्-˚प्रीणित mfn. made completely happy, thoroughly satisfied, well pleased, MārkP.
सम्-प्रीत mfn. completely satisfied or pleased, delighted, MBh.
सम्-प्रीत—मानस mfn. delighted in mind, ib.
सम्-˚प्रीति f. complete satisfaction, joy, delight in (loc. or comp.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
attachment, affection, good will, friendship with (instr. with or without सह), love for (loc. or gen.), Mn.; MBh. &c.
सम्-˚प्रीति—मत् mfn. satisfied, pleased, delighted, MBh.
सम्-प्र-√ भा P. -भाति, to shine forth clearly, be conspicuous, appear, MBh.

सम्-प्रभव m. coming forth, rising, appearance (only ifc.), VarBṛS.

m: सम्-प्रधारण n. (and f(आ). ) determination, deliberation, deciding on the propriety or impropriety of anything, Bhar.; Daśar.; Sāh.
सम्-˚प्रधारित mfn. fixed or determined upon, deliberated about, MW.
सम्-˚प्रधार्य mfn. to be considered or deliberated about, R.
सम्-प्र-√ 1. धाव् to run quite away, hurry off, escape, MBh.; to hasten towards, be attracted, BhP.

सम्-प्र-√ धृ Caus. -धारयति, to direct towards, deliver over to (dat.), MBh.; (with बुद्धिम्) to fix the mind or thoughts steadily upon (loc.), determine, resolve, settle, decide, ib.; Śiś.; (with or without बुद्ध्या, मनसा, or हृदये) to ponder, reflect, consider, deliberate or think about (acc.), Mn.; MBh.; Kāv. &c.: Pass. -धार्यते, to be fixed upon or determined, MBh.
सम्-प्र-√ धृष् Caus. -धर्षयति, to offer violence to, outrage, insult, violate, hurt, MBh.
सम्-प्र-√ घृष् P. -घर्षति, to rub into or on Suśr.
सम्-प्रख्यान n., Mahāvy.
सम्-प्रणाद m. sound, noise, Hariv.
सम्-˚प्रणादित mfn. (fr. Caus.) made to resound, R.
सम्-प्र-णी (√ नी) P. Ā. -णयति, ˚ते to bring together, collect, raise (taxes), MBh.; to compose, ib.; (with दण्डम्) to apply the rod, inflict punishment on (loc.), Mn. vii, 16.
सम्-प्रणीत mfn. brought together, MBh.
composed (as poetry), ib.
सम्-प्र-णश् (√ 2. नश्) P. -णश्यति, to be lost, vanish, disappear, MBh.
सम्-प्र-णद् (√ नद्) P. Ā. -णदति, ˚ते, to cry out, cry, R. : Caus. See -णादित.
सम्-प्र-णम् (√ नम्) P. -णमति to bow down or bend one's self before (acc.), ib.
सम्-प्र-णर्दित mfn. (√ नर्द्) roared out, bellowed, W.

m: सम्-प्रणेतृ m. a leader, chief (of an army), MBh.
a ruler, judge, W.
(with दण्डस्य) ‘applier of the rod’, in inflicter of punishment, Mn. vii, 26
a maintainer, sustainer, MBh.
सम्-प्र-णि-√ धा P. Ā. -दधाति, -धत्ते, to leave behind in (loc.), MBh.; to put aside, disregard, ib.
सम्-प्र-णुद् (√ नुद्) P. Ā. णुदति, ˚ते to drive or press forward, urge on, remove or move away from (abl.), MBh.
सम्-प्रणुदित mfn. driven or urged on ib.
सम्-प्र-शान्त mfn. (√ शम्) ceased, disappeared, MBh.
सम्-प्र-√ शास् P. -शास्ति, (with रज्यम्) to exercise government, bear sway, rule, reign, MBh.
सम्-प्रश्न m. asking, inquiring about (comp.), inquiry, question (˚प्रश्नोऽत्र न विद्यते, ‘there is here no question, it is a matter of course’), RV.; MBh.; Kāv. &c.
courteous inquiry, MW.
a refuge, asylum (Ved.), ib.

सम्-प्रश्रय m. respectful demeanour, modesty, humbleness, BhP.
सम्-प्रश्रित mfn. modest, humble, well-behaved, MW.
सम्-प्रथा (prob.) w.r. for सुप्रथाः, Rājat.
सम्-प्रथान n. the act of setting out together, setting out on a journey, departure, W.
सम्-प्रथित mfn. (√ प्रथ्) universally known or celebrated, MBh.
सम्-प्र-√ बाध् Ā. -बाधते, to press or drive back, repel, resist, MBh.; to oppress, pain, torment, R.
सम्-˚प्रबोधित mfn. (fr. Caus.) convinced, persuaded, Hariv.
consulted or deliberated about, ib.
सम्-प्र-√ बुध् Ā. -बुध्यते, to awake i.e. begin to take effect (as a spell or incantation), Cat. : Caus. -बोधयति, to rouse up, awaken, ŚBr.
सम्-प्रबुद्ध mfn. roused up, awakened, MBh.

सम्-प्र-√ चक्ष् Ā. -चष्टे, to explain, expound, ib.; to suppose, assume, BhP.

सम्-प्र-√ 1. चि P. Ā. -चिनोति, -चिनुते, to gather, increase, MBh.
सम्-प्रचोदित mf(आ)n. urged on, impelled, incited, MBh.
required, R.
सम्-प्र-√ चुद् Caus. -चोदयति, to urge on or impel quickly, set in rapid motion, incite, drive on; to promote, encourage, MW.
सम्-प्र-√ च्यु Caus. -च्यावयति, to cause to proceed or come forth from different directions, bring together, TS.

सम्-प्र-√ 1. दा P. Ā. -ददाति, -दत्ते, (ind.p. -दायम्), to give completely up or deliver wholly over, surrender, give (also in marriage), PañcavBr.; MBh. &c.; to transmit, hand down by tradition, impart, teach, MBh.; KātyŚr., Sch.; Cat.; to grant, bestow, MBh. : Caus. -दापयति, to cause to give over or transmit, R. : Desid. -दित्सति, to wish to give over, Nir.

relating to the tradition (of any doctrine), Suśr.

सम्-प्र-√ हृष् P. Ā. -हृष्यति, ˚ते., to rejoice greatly, be exceedingly glad, thrill with pleasure, MBh.; Kāv. &c.: Caus. -हर्षयति, to rejoice, make glad, comfort, ŚāṅkhBr.; MBh. &c.
सम्-प्रहृष्ट mfn. excessively rejoiced, rejoicing, joyful, MBh.; R. &c.
erect, bristling (or ‘standing on end’, as the hair of the body), thrilling, ib.
सम्-प्रहृष्ट—मनस् mfn. overjoyed in heart, R.
सम्-प्रहृष्ट—मुख mfn. having the face radiant with joy, MBh.
सम्-प्रहृष्ट—तनूरुह mfn. having the hairs of the body bristling with delight, MBh.
सम्-प्र-हित mfn. (√ हि) thrown, hurled, MBh.
सम्-˚प्रजान (?) id., L.
सम्-प्रजाता f. (a cow) which has calved, Gobh.
सम्-प्रजात mfn. produced, arisen, MW.
सम्-प्र-√ ज्ञा P. Ā. -जानति, -जनीते, to distinguish, discern, recognize, know accurately or perfectly, MBh.; Hariv.
सम्-प्रज्ञा˚तावस्था f. the above state, ib.
सम्-प्रज्ञात mfn. distinguished, discerned, known accurately, Yogas.
सम्-प्रज्ञात—योगिन् m. a Yogin who is still in a state of consciousness, KapS., Sch.
सम्-प्र-√ जन् Ā. -जायते, to be produced, spring up, arise from (abl.), R.; Pañcat.; to exist, be existent, Pañcat.; to be born again, MBh.
सम्-प्रजन्य (?) n. full consciousness, Divyāv.
सम्-प्र-√ ज्वल् P. -ज्वलति, to flame or blaze up, catch fire, MBh.; Hariv.; R. : Caus. -ज्वालयति, to light up, kindle, MBh.
सम्-प्रज्वलित mfn. flaming, blazing, ib.
lighted, kindled, MW.
सम्-प्र-√ काश् Ā. -काशते, to become manifest, be visible, appear; to shine, glitter, MBh.; R. : Caus. -काशयति, to illuminate, make manifest, discover, Lalit.
सम्-प्रकाश m. bright appearance, Bhaṭṭ.
सम्-˚प्रकाशक mfn. manifesting, announcing, directing, Lalit.
सम्-˚प्रकाशन n. manifestation, discovering, Kām.
सम्-˚प्रकाशन—ता f. the taking place of a manifestation, Buddh.
सम्-˚प्रकाशित mfn. made manifest, displayed, MBh.
सम्-˚प्रकाश्य mfn. to be manifested or displayed, Pañcat.
सम्-प्र-कीर्ण mfn. (√ कॄ) mixed, mingled (अ-स्˚), ŚāṅkhŚr.
सम्-प्रकीर्तित mf(आ)n. mentioned, MBh.
designated, called, Bhag.; Pañcat.; Suśr.
सम्-प्रकल्पित mfn. (fr. Caus.) installed, disposed, settled, MBh.
सम्-प्र-√ कम्प् Ā. -कम्पते, to tremble or be greatly agitated, shiver, Kāṭh. : Caus. -कम्पयति, to cause to tremble, agitate, R.
सम्-प्र-√ कृ P. Ā. -करोति, -कुरुते, to produce or effect together, Car.; to perform, begin, MBh.; to effect, render, cause anything to become (with two acc.), R.
सम्-प्र-√ कृष् P. -कर्षति, to drag along with, MBh.
सम्-प्र-√ क्लिश् P. -क्लिश्नाति, to crush or press together, knead, squeeze, ĀpŚr.
सम्-प्र-√ क्रम् Ā. -क्रमते, to proceed to do or set about anything, to begin (with acc. or inf.), MBh.; R.
सम्-प्र-√ कॢप् Caus. -कल्पयति, to install, MBh.; to regulate, appoint, settle, Kāty.
सम्-प्रकॢप्त mfn. prepared, arranged, Bhaṭṭ.
well provided with, MW.
सम्-प्र-क्षाल mfn. (√ 2. क्षल्) performing the prescribed ablutions, MBh.
सम्-प्र-क्षाल m. a kind of hermit or holy man, R.
सम्-प्रक्षालनी (ई), f. (scil. वृत्ति) a partic. kind of livelihood, Baudh.
सम्-प्रक्षालन n. the act of washing entirely away, destruction (of the world) by inundation, ib.
complete ablution, purification by water, MW.
bathing, ib.
सम्-प्र-√ क्षै Caus. -क्षापयति, to extinguish, TS.
सम्-प्र-√ क्षिप् P. Ā. -क्षिपति, ˚ते, to throw or hurl at, cast, MBh.
सम्-प्र-√ क्षुभ् P. Ā. -क्षुभ्यति, -क्षोभते, to be shaken or agitated, become confused, R.
सम्-प्रक्षुभित mfn. shaken, tossed about
सम्-प्रक्षुभित—मानस mfn. agitated or confused or perplexed in mind, R.
सम्-प्रलाप m. talk, chatter, Sāh.
सम्-प्र-√ ली Ā. -लीयते, to be completely dissolved in (loc.), become absorbed, disappear, vanish, MBh.; BhP.
सम्-प्रलीन mfn. wholly dissolved or melted away, disappeared, vanished, R.
absorbed i.e. contained in (loc.), MBh.
सम्-प्र-√ लुभ् Caus. -लोभयति, to allure or entice away, try to seduce or deceive, MBh.
सम्-प्र-√ लुप् Pass. -लुप्यते, to be violated or injured, MBh.
सम्-प्रमाद See अ-स्˚.
सम्-प्रमापण n. (fr. सम् + 2. प्र्˚) killing, slaughter, Yājñ., Sch.
सम्-प्र-मार्ग m. (√ मृज्) purification, Gobh., Sch.
सम्-प्रमूढ mfn. utterly bewildered or confused, perplexed, embarrassed, MBh.
सम्-प्र-√ मथ् (or -मन्थ्) P. -मथति, -मन्थति, or -मथ्नाति (ind.p. -मथ्य, q.v.), to stir about or agitate violently, violate, outrage, oppress, harass, annoy, MBh.; to tear out (the eyes), R.
सम्-प्रमथ्य ind. violently, by force, R.
सम्-प्रमर्दन See सम्-प्र. √ मृद् below.
सम्-प्रमर्दन mfn. crushing down, destroying, ib.
सम्-प्र-मत्त mfn. (√ मद्) very excited (said of an elephant in rut), Hariv.
very careless, thoughtless, neglectful, MBh.
very fond of (inf.), ib. viii, 3509 (B. सम्-प्र-वृत्त).
सम्-प्रमेह m. morbid flow of urine, Car.
सम्-प्र-√ मृद् (only ind.p. -मृद्य), to trample or crush to pieces, destroy, MBh.
सम्-प्रमोद m. excessive joy or delight, MBh.
सम्-प्रमोह m. utter bewilderment, embarrassment, infatuation, MBh.
सम्-प्र-√ मोक्ष् P. Ā. -मोक्षयति, ˚ते, to make free, clear away (Ā. ‘to clear a way for one's self’), MBh.
सम्-प्रमोष m. carrying off, abstraction, loss (= नाश), BhP.
सम्-प्रमुखित mfn. (see प्रमुख) placed at the head, foremost, first, chief, Lalit.
सम्-प्र-√ मुच् P. Ā. -मुञ्चति, ˚ते (ind.p. -मुच्य, q.v.), to loosen entirely, set quite free, deliberate, ŚāṅkhBr. : Pass. -मुच्यते, to free one's self from, get rid of (abl.), GopBr.
सम्-प्रमुच्य ind. having abandoned or quitted, being quite free from (abl.), ŚBr.
सम्-प्रमुग्ध mfn. completely confused
सम्-प्रमुग्ध—त्व n. confusion, perturbation, Pat.

सम्-प्र-√ मुह् P. Ā. -मुह्यति, ˚ते to become completely stupefied or embarrassed, be perplexed or unconscious, MBh.; to be obscured or darkened, R. : Caus. -मोहयति, to completely perplex, confuse, embarrass, MBh.
सम्-प्रमुक्ति f. letting loose (cattle), Kāṭh.
सम्-प्र-मुषित mfn. (√ मुष्) carried quite away, abstracted, distracted, L.
सम्-प्रनष्ट mfn. (Pāṇ. viii, 4, 36) vanished, disappeared, ib.
सम्-प्र-नृत्त mfn. (√ नृत्) beginning to dance or move about, MBh.
सम्-प्र-√ पीड् Caus. -पीडयति, to press well together, Car.
सम्-प्रपीडित mfn. greatly afflicted or harassed, MBh.
सम्-प्र-√ पूज् Caus. -पूजयति, to honour greatly, revere, Hariv.
सम्-प्र-√ पच् Pass. -पच्यते, to become quite ripe or mature, come to a head (as a boil &c.), Suśr.

सम्-प्र-√ पद् Ā. -पद्यते (in some forms also P.), to go towards or enter together, approach, enter (acc.), AitBr.; BhP.; to set out (on a journey acc.), Hariv.; to betake one's self or have recourse to (acc.), MBh.; Hariv.; BhP.; to succeed, be accomplished, Pañcat.; to become, be turned into (-सात्), Bhaṭṭ.; to set about, begin, MW.

s: klI, (saM + pra + pada gatO + kaH .) BramaRam । paryyawanam । iti kecit ॥ (yaTA, yAjYavalke । 3 । 51 । “svapyAd BUmO SucO rAtrO divAsaMprapadErnayet । sTAnAsanavihArErvA yogAByAsena vA taTA ॥”)
m: सम्-प्रपद n. pl. standing on tiptoe, Yājñ. iii, 51 (cf. Mn. vi, 21).
सम्-प्रपन्न mfn. gone together towards, entered &c.
one who has recourse to (acc.), MBh.
(ifc.) endowed or filled with, Caurap.
सम्-प्रपुष्पित mfn. richly furnished with blossoms or flowers, R.
सम्-प्र-√ 2. रुध् Pass. -रुध्यते, to be completely debarred from, be deprived of (v.l. सम्-अव-र्˚), Hariv.
सम्-प्र-√ रुच् Ā. -रोचते to appear very bright or beautiful, appear good or right, please, MBh.
सम्-प्र-रुष्ट mfn. (√ रुष्) greatly enraged or irritated, furious, MBh.
सम्-प्र-√ साध् Caus. -साधयति, to accomplish, settle, set right (see below); to make one's own, acquire, MW.

v: na॰ sam + pra + sADaM--Ric karaRe lyuw । 1 kawakAdo BUzaRe । BAve lyuw । 2 BUzaRakriyAyAm ।
m: सम्-प्रसाधन n. accomplishing, arranging, decorating, Car.; Bhpr.
the act of effecting or accomplishing, W.
सम्-˚प्रसाध्य mfn. to be accomplished or set right, Kām.

v: pu॰ sam + pra + sada--karaRe॰ GaY । 1 yogAdiSAKokte cittasya nErmalyasampAdake prayatnaBede । BAve GaY । 2 samyakprasannatAyAm । ADAre GaY । 3 suzuptO “tadyatrEtatsuptaH samastaH samprasannaH svapnaM vijAnAtIti” SrutiH । sanDyaSabde ca suzuptiSabde dfSyam ।
m: सम्-प्रसाद m. perfect quiet (esp. mental repose during deep sleep), ŚBr.; Lalit.
favour, grace, Uttarar.
serenity, Bhaṭṭ. (v.l.)
(in Vedānta) the soul during deep sleep, ChUp.; MBh. &c.
trust, confidence, W.
सम्-˚प्रसादन mfn. (fr. Caus.) calming, sedative, Car.
सम्-प्रसार m. one through whom all goes on well, BrahmUp.

s: klI, (saM + pra + sf + Ric + lyuw .) vya karaRasya saMjYAviSezaH । yaTA । igyaRaH saMprasAraRam । yaRasTAne prayujyamAno ya ik sa saMprasAraRasaMjYaH syAt । iti sidDAntakImudI ॥
v: na॰ sam + pra + sf--Ric--lyuw । 1 samyagvistAraRe vyAkaraRokte yaRaH sTAne jAyamAne 2 iksaMjYavakarRe ca । “ik yaRa samprasAraRam” pA॰ ।
m: सम्-˚प्रसारण n. drawing asunder, Anup.
(in gram.) the mutual interchange of the vowels इ, उ, ऋ, ऌ, and their corresponding semivowels य्, व्, र्, ल्, Pāṇ. i, 1, 45 &c.

सम्-प्र-√ स्था Ā. -तिष्ठते, to take up a position together (before the altar), ŚāṅkhBr.; to set out together, depart, proceed, advance, approach, go to (acc. or loc.), PraśnUp.; MBh. &c.: Caus. स्थापयति, to dispatch, send out to (acc.), R.
सम्-प्रस्थित mfn. set out on a journey, departed, MBh.; R. &c.
advancing towards Buddha hood (?), Divyāv.
सम्-प्र-√ 2. सू Ā. -सूते, or -सूयते, to bring forth, beget, generate, Mn.; MBh. : Pass. सूयते (or ˚ति), to be born, MBh. iii, 12978.
सम्-प्रसूत mfn. brought forth, begot, procreated, MuṇḍUp.; MBh. &c.
सम्-˚प्रसूति f. bringing forth together or at the same time, VarBṛS.
सम्-प्र-√ सञ्ज् Pass. -सज्जते (ep. also ˚ति), to cling to, be attached to or fond of (loc. or instr.), MBh.
सम्-प्र-√ सद् P. -सीदति, to settle down quietly, be soothed, be kindly disposed or gracious towards (gen.), MBh.; R. &c.: Caus. -सादयति, to appease, propitiate, ib.
सम्-प्र-√ सह् P. -सहति (fut. -सहिष्यति, or -सक्ष्यति v.l. -शक्ष्यति), to have power over, become a match for, withstand, check, curb, restrain, MBh.; to endure, tolerate, ib.; to overcome, ib.
सम्-प्रसह्य ind. thoroughly, by all means, MBh.
सम्-प्रसक्त mfn. devoted to, intent upon, occupied with (अत्र), MBh.
lasting, continuous, permanent, R.

v: tri॰ । 1 samyakprasanne 2 suzupte ca samprasAdaSabde dfSyam
m: सम्-प्रसन्न mfn. soothed, appeased, ChUp.
propitious, favourable, gracious, BhP.
सम्-प्रसर्पण n. moving along, ŚāṅkhŚr.
सम्-प्रसत्ति f. = सम्-प्रसाद (in Vedānta), Śaṃk.
सम्-प्रसव m. (सम् + 2. प्र्˚) admission, Kull. on Mn. viii, 112 (v.l. प्रति-प्र्˚).
सम्-प्र-√ सृ Caus. -सारयति, ˚ते, to stretch or spread out, extend, VS.; TS.; MaitrS.; Hcat.; to draw asunder, ĀpŚr.
सम्-प्र-√ सृप् P. -सर्पति, to approach or enter in a creeping way, ŚBr.
सम्-प्र-√ सिच् Pass. -सिच्यते, to flow out, issue, Hariv.; Suśr.
सम्-प्र-सिद्ध mfn. (√ 3. सिध्) well prepared, cooked, Suśr.
सम्-प्रसिद्धि f. success, good luck, Divyāv.
सम्-प्र-√ स्पृश् P. -स्पृशति, to touch or sprinkle with water, wash, bathe, MW.
सम्-प्र-√ स्रु P. -स्रवति, to flow forth together, issue from (abl.), Up.; R. : Caus. स्रावयति, to cause to run together, mix, mingle, TBr.
सम्-प्रस्तार m. = प्र-स्तोतृ, Hariv. (Nīlak.)
सम्-प्र-स्तुत mfn. (√ स्तु) ready to, prepared for (inf.), Rājat.
सम्-प्र-सुप्त mfn. (√ स्वप्) fallen fast asleep, sleeping, MBh.
closed (not expanded, as a flower), ib.
सम्-˚प्रतापन n. (fr. Caus.) the act of heating, Suśr.
inflicting great pain, afflicting, W.
N. of a hell, Mn.; Yājñ.; Viṣṇ.
सम्-प्र-√ तॄ P. -तरति, to cross over (acc.), Naiṣ.

सम्-प्रती (-प्रति- √ 5. इ) P. -प्रत्येति, to go towards, arrive at, come to a firm conviction, believe firmly in, trust in (gen.), R.; Bhaṭṭ.; Pass. -प्रतीयते, to be meant or understood, Pat. : Caus. -प्रत्याययति, to cause to be meant or understood by, ib.
सम्-प्रतीक्ष् (-प्रति-√ ईक्ष्) Ā. -प्रतीक्षते (ind.p. -प्रतीक्ष्य, q.v.), to look out for, wait for, await, expect, MBh.
सम्-˚प्रतीक्षा f. expectation, W.
सम्-प्रतीक्ष mfn. expecting (ifc.), Śiś.
1. सम्-˚प्रतीक्ष्य mfn. to be expected, Yājñ.
2. सम्-˚प्रतीक्ष्य ind. while waiting for i.e. a long time, MBh.
सम्-प्रतीत mfn. come back again, returned, BhP.
firmly believing in, fully convinced of MBh.
firmly resolved, ib.
thoroughly ascertained or admitted, well known, renowned, ib.
respectful, compliant, MW.

s: strI, samyakKyAtiH । samyagjYAnam । saMpratipUrvvenaDAtoH ktinpratyayena nizpannam ॥
m: सम्-प्रतीति f. complete belief or trust, full knowledge, notoriety, fame, Kir.
respect for, compliance, MW.
सम्-प्रतीष् (-प्रति- √ 3. इष्) P. -प्रतीच्छति, to wish together with, assent to, agree, promise, MW.
सम्-प्र-√ तप् Caus. -तापयति, to warm, TBr., Sch.
सम्-प्रतप्त mfn. excessively heated, MW.
greatly pained, tortured, ib.
suffering pain, distressed, Suśr.; Kām.
सम्-प्रतर्दन mfn. (prob.) cleaving, piercing (v.l. ˚प्रमर्दन), MBh.
सम्-प्र-√ तर्क् P. -तर्कयति, to form a clear conclusion or conjecture, MW.; to consider as, think, regard (with two acc.), Hariv.

s: vya, (sam ca prati ca dvayoH samAhAraH .) asmin kAle । tatparyyAyaH । etarhi 2 idAnIM 3 aDunA 4 sAMpratam 5 । ityamaraH । 3 । 4 । 23 ॥ (yaTA, BAgavate । 7 । 1 । 17 । “sampratyamarzI govinde dantavakraSca durmmatiH ॥”)
v: avya॰ sam + prati + samAhAradvandvaH । idAnImityarTe amaraH ।
m: 1. सम्-प्रति ind. directly over, against or opposite, close in front of (acc.), ŚBr.; PārGṛ.
rightly, in the right way, at the right time, Br.; ChUp.
exactly, just, TS.; ŚBr.; ChUp.
now, at this moment, at present, Kāv.; RāmatUp.; VarBṛS. &c.
(with impf.) immediately, at once, Kathās.
2. सम्-प्रति m. N. of the 24th Arhat of the past Utsarpiṇī, L.
of a son of Kuṇāla, HPariś.

k.v: एतर्हि संप्रतीदानीमधुना साम्प्रतं तथा। दिग्देशकाले पूर्वादौ प्रागुदक्प्रत्यगादयः॥

m: सम्-प्रति-√ भा P. -भाति, to shine out fully, appear, seem, MBh.; to appear clearly, be fully understood, ib.
सम्-प्रतिभास m. perception which tends to combine or unite, Sāṃkhyas. Sch.
सम्-प्रति-√ भाष् Ā. -भाषते, to speak in return, answer, MBh.
सम्-प्रति-√ श्रु (only ind.p. -श्रुत्य), to listen attentively to, assent, promise, BhP. : Caus. -श्रावयति, to make to promise or repeat a promise, remind of a promise, R.
सम्-प्रति-√ बुध् Caus. -बोधयति, to rouse up or awaken thoroughly, MBh.
सम्-प्रति-√ ग्रह् P. Ā. -गृह्णाति, -गृह्णीते, to receive hospitably, welcome, MBh.
सम्-प्रतिग्रह m. kind reception, predilection for, Jātakam.
सम्-प्रति-√ हन् Pass. -हन्यते, to hurt one's self, strike (instr.) against, Car.
सम्-प्रति-√ ज्ञा P. Ā. -जानाति, -जनीते, to promise, MBh.
सम्-प्रतिज्ञात mfn. promised, ib.
सम्-प्रति-√ लक्ष् Pass. -लक्ष्यते, to be seen or perceived clearly, MBh.
सम्-प्रति-मुक्त mfn. (√ मुच्) firmly or completely bound, fastened, BhP.
सम्-प्रति-√ नन्द् P. -नन्दति, to greet or welcome gladly (see next).
सम्-प्रतिनन्दित mfn. greeted joyfully, welcomed, MBh.
सम्-प्रतिपादन n. (fr. Caus.) the act of causing to receive, delivering or giving over to, granting, Kām.
appointing to (loc.), MBh.
सम्-प्रतिपादित mfn. (fr. id.) delivered over, bestowed, given, BhP.
सम्-प्रति-√ पाल् (only Pass. -पाल्यते), to expect, wait for, Hariv.
सम्-प्रति-√ पूज् (only ind.p. -पूज्य), to honour greatly, revere, respect, R.
सम्-प्रतिपूजा f. great respect or reverence, Pat. on Pāṇ. v, 3, 99.
सम्-प्रति˚पूजित mfn. greatly honoured, much respected, MBh.

सम्-प्रति-√ पद् Ā. -पद्यते, to go towards together, go near to, approach, arrive at (acc.), Gaut.; Suśr.; to addict one's self to, indulge in (acc.), Pañcat.; to attain to, obtain, recover, R.; Hariv.; to be fully agreed about, agree upon, assent to (acc. or loc.), MBh.; R.; to consider, regard as (two acc.), Kum.; to come to pass, arise, MW.; to bring about, perform, accomplish, MBh. : Caus. -पादयति, to cause to come to or receive, bestow, grant, give over to (gen. or loc.), MBh.; BhP.
सम्-प्रतिपन्न mfn. gone near, come up to, approached, attained, arrived, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
agreed upon or assented to, acknowledged, recognized, Yājñ., Sch.; Kull.
brought about, performed, W.

agreement, concurrence, acknowledgement, admission, assent, affirmation, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
going against, assault, W.

co-operation, W.
bringing about, performing, effecting, ib.

सम्-प्रति-प्राण m. the chief breath, AitĀr.

m: सम्-प्रतिरोधक m. complete restraint, confinement, imprisonment, obstruction, Yājñ.
सम्-प्रतिसंचर m. re-absorption or resolution (ब्राह्मःसम्-प्रतिसंचर, ‘re-absorption into Brahma’), MBh.
सम्-प्रति-वेधकी or सम्-प्रति-वेधिकी, f. (√ व्यध्) opening, disclosing, Divyāv.
सम्-प्रति—विद् mfn. knowing (only) the present (not what is beyond), having only common sense, KauṣUp.
सम्-प्रति-√ विद् Caus. -वेदयति√ 1. to cause to be fully known, announce, report, relate, MBh.

सम्-प्रति-ष्ठा (√ स्था) P. -तिष्ठति to stand firmly on, rely on (loc.), MBh. : Caus. -ष्ठापयति, to enclose, confine (as cows), MBh.; to concentrate in (loc.), ChUp.; to make firm, establish, MBh.; to found, introduce, BhP.
सम्-प्रतिष्ठा f. perseverance, BhP.
permanence, continuance (as opp. to, ‘beginning’ or ‘end’), Bhag.
high rank or position, MBh.
सम्-˚प्रतिष्ठान n. a means for supporting (the frame) or keeping one's self upright, Car.
सम्-˚प्रतिष्ठित mfn. standing or resting firmly on (loc.), established, fixed, settled, Up.; MBh.
lasting, existing, being, Cat.
सम्-प्रति-षिध् (√ 2. सिध्) P. -षेधति, to ward off, keep at a distance, MBh.
सम्-प्रतोली f. = प्रतोली (q.v.), MBh.
सम्-प्रत्ति See सम्-प्र- √ 1. दा.
सम्-प्रत्ति f. (for सम्-प्रदत्ति) giving entirely up, delivering over, ŚBr.
सम्-प्रत्ति—कर्मन् n. the act of delivering over, KauṣUp., Sch.
सम्-प्र-√ तुष् P. -तुष्यति, to be or become quite satisfied, be contented, MBh.
सम्-प्रत्य्-आ-गत mfn. (√ गम्) come back, returned, MBh.
सम्-˚प्रत्यायक mf(इका)n. (fr. Caus.) causing any one to mean anything (gen.) by (-त्व n.), Pat.
सम्-˚प्रत्यायक—त्व n.
सम्-प्रत्य्-अवेक्षणता f. (√ ईक्ष्) complete perception or comprehension.
सम्-प्रत्यय m. assent, agreement (see यथा-स्˚)
firm conviction, perfect trust or faith or belief, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
right conception, Pat.; KātyŚr., Sch.
notion, idea, VarBṛS.
सम्-प्रत्यय See सम्-प्रती.
सम्-प्रवाद m. id., AitĀr.
सम्-प्रवादन n. (fr. Caus.) the act of causing to sound together or at the same time, ĀpGṛ., Sch.
सम्-प्रवादित n. causing to sound together, Lalit.
सम्-प्रवाह m. continuous stream, uninterrupted continuity, Kād.; BhP.
सम्-प्र-√ वच् P. -वक्ति, to explain or declare together, ŚāṅkhBr.; to relate at full or comprehensively, declare, communicate, announce, Mn.; MBh. &c.

सम्-प्र-√ वद् P. Ā. -वदति, ˚ते (Ved. inf. -वदितोस्), to pronounce aloud, PañcavBr.; (P.) to utter cries together, sing together, Pāṇ. i, 3, 48, Sch.; (Ā.) to talk or converse together, Bhaṭṭ.; Caus. वादयति See below.
सम्-प्रवदन n. talking together, conversation, W.
सम्-प्रवर्तक mfn. (fr. Caus.) setting in motion, promoting, furthering, Kām.
producing, creating (applied to Śiva), MBh.
सम्-˚प्रवर्तन n. moving or hurrying about, Kām.
the act of setting in motion or action, undertaking, MW.
सम्-˚प्रवर्तिन् mfn. putting in order, setting right, Car.
सम्-प्र-√ वे P. Ā. -वयति, ˚ते, to interweave, sew or string together, connect, ŚāṅkhBr.
सम्-प्रवेश m. entering into together, complete entrance, going into (loc. or comp.), KātyŚr.; MBh.; R.
place of entrance, place entered by (gen.), MBh.
सम्-˚प्रवेशित mfn. (fr. Caus.) made or allowed to enter or return (opp. to निर्-वासित, ‘exiled’), Rājat.
सम्-प्र-√ वेष्ट् Caus. -वेष्टयति, to wind round, Suśr.
सम्-प्र-√ 2. वृ Caus. -वारयति, to wait on, entertain, Divyāv.
सम्-प्र-√ वृध् Ā. -वर्धते, to grow well up, attain full growth, grow, increase, MBh.; Kāv. &c.: Caus. -वर्धयति, to cause to grow or increase, R.

सम्-प्रवृत्त mfn. gone forward, proceeded, set off, BhP.
arisen, existent, present, near at hand, ib.
commenced, begun, MBh.; R.
passed, gone by, W.
setting about anything (inf. dat., or loc.), MBh.
engaged in (loc. or comp.), ib.
सम्-प्रवृत्ति f. (only pl.) coming forth, appearance, occurrence, MBh.
सम्-प्र-वृष्ट mfn. (√ वृष्) begun to rain, MBh.
सम्-प्र-वृष्ट n. what has been completely rained, a whole rainfall, VarBṛS.

सम्-प्र-√ विश् P. -विशति (ep. also ˚ते), to enter into together or completely (with मानसम्, or ध्यानम्, ‘to be lost in thought’), ĀśvGṛ.; MBh. &c.; to have commerce or intercourse with (acc.), MBh.; to be sexually united with (acc.), Mn.; MBh. : Caus. -वेशयति, to cause to enter, introduce, lead into (acc. or loc.), R.; Hariv. &c.
सम्-प्र-वि-√ चर् Caus. -चारयति, to examine or consider carefully, R.
सम्-प्रविद्ध mfn. full grown, increased, swelled, enhanced, well advanced, MBh.; VarBṛS.; Kām.
rich in (instr.), MBh.
सम्-प्र-वि-√ हृ (only ind. -हृत्य), to roam or wander all over (acc.), MBh.
सम्-प्रविलापन n. dissolving, causing to disappear, MBh., Sch.
सम्-प्र-√ विप् Ā. -वेपते, to tremble violently, MBh.
सम्-प्रविष्ट mfn. entered together or completely, gone into, R.; Kathās. &c.
सम्-प्र-व्यथित mfn. (√ व्यथ्) greatly troubled or alarmed, R.

सम्-प्र-√ या P. याति, to proceed or set off together, to advance towards, go to (acc. with or without प्रति), ŚāṅkhŚr.; MBh. &c.; to move, revolve (as the heavenly bodies), Sūryas.; to go (together) to any state or condition (acc.), VarBṛS.
सम्-प्रयाण n. proceeding together towards, setting out, departure, MBh.; BhP.
सम्-प्र-√ याच् Ā. -याचते, to ask for together, solicit, beg, request (two acc.), MBh.
सम्-प्रयास m. great exertion, effort, exhaustion, BhP.
सम्-˚प्रयात mfn. gone forth together &c.
proceeding with i.e. making use of, employing (instr.), MBh.

सम्-प्र-√ यम् P. Ā. -यच्छति, ˚ते, to offer or present or bestow together (Ā. also, ‘mutually’), give or present to (dat. gen. accord. to Pāṇ. i, 3, 55 also instr.), RV. &c. &c.; to give in marriage, MBh.; to give back, restore, R.
सम्-प्र-√ यत् Ā. -यतते, to strive eagerly for, exert one's self about, be intent upon (dat.), Kām.

wishing to get at, waylaying, ib.

सम्-प्रेर्ण mfn. risen up together, MW.

सम्-प्रेष् (-प्र- √ 1. इष्) P. -प्रेष्यति, to send forth, throw, fling, cast, MW.; (in Vedic ritual) to summon, invite (cf. 2. प्रेष्), Br.; ŚrS. : Caus. -प्रेषयति, to send forth together, send away, despatch, send, dismiss, MBh.; R. &c.; to send a message to (gen.), MBh.; to direct (the thoughts) towards (loc.), Lalit.

dismissal, R.

summoned, invited, ĀśvŚr.
सम्-प्रिया (आ), f. N. of the wife of Vidūratha (or Vidūra), MBh.
